description: This file defines an Android activity class 'CustomizeExitActivity' that handles splash screen exit animation, app startup delay simulation, and shortcut creation. It uses various Android animation APIs and system services to customize the splash screen exit behavior and provide user interaction features.

classes.name: CustomizeExitActivity
classes.description: An activity that manages splash screen exit animation, simulates application delay, and provides shortcut creation functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up splash screen exit animation, and delays app readiness.

methods.name: onSplashScreenExit
methods.description: Handles the splash screen exit animation, including translation, fading, and content margin animations.

methods.name: createContentAnimation
methods.description: Creates a ValueAnimator to animate margins of content views within a layout.

methods.name: createShortcutButton
methods.description: Creates a button to generate a dynamic shortcut when clicked.

methods.name: createShortcut
methods.description: Builds and adds a dynamic shortcut to the app using ShortcutManager.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Terminates the activity process for demo purposes on pause.
